Outside-review checklist

This is the shortest handoff path for someone arriving cold: boundary, clean launch, reviewer pass, receipt, observation triage, optional diagnostics, and exportable review notes.

OR-01: Read boundary before launching
Launcher boundary explicitly says deterministic browser-local shell, no LLM, no consciousness, no moral patienthood, no production persistence, and no finished gameplay.
Done
OR-02: Launch clean reviewer path
Launch clean demo opens the maintained v61 shell with reviewer-focus mode, not a parallel simulation.
Done
OR-03: Run reviewer pass inside the shell
Reviewer landing reports PASSABLE_REVIEW_PATH and the integrated scenario receipt reports ALL_PASS.
Done
OR-04: Inspect transcript, receipt, and observation triage
Session transcript, integrated receipt, and observation triage are visible before optional deep panels.
Done
OR-05: Audit failures if the receipt is incomplete
Audit failures converts failing receipt fields into blocking observation rows with recovery guidance.
Done
OR-06: Reveal deep panels only for unresolved questions
Toggle deep panels exposes trace, checkpoints, resident history, social memory, receipt observations, playtest tasks, and QA manifest.
Done
OR-07: Record manual outcome and export handoff
Manual pass recorder, defect ledger, and outside-review handoff export are prepared as browser-local public review evidence.
Done
Refresh shell evidence

7/7 outside-review checklist items complete.
